name: Hurwal Divide Traverse
approach: From Hurricane Creek Trailhead, walk the Hurricane Creek Trail about 1.8 miles to the unsigned, unmaintained Thorp Creek trail on the right. Ford Hurricane Creek (cold and fast early in the season), cross the wide cobbled wash of Twin Creek without losing the tread, then climb steep switchbacks through burned forest and blowdown to Thorp Creek Meadows below Sacajawea. Fill up on water here: it is the last reliable source until you are back down at Hurricane Creek.
